text: The old C-10 test asserted over a SampledSpan literal and never called FromReadingList or RecordVerdict, so it passed whatever those functions did. These two tests drive both production paths; I verified by mutation that each fails when the axes are collapsed — deriving Reviewed from Verdict in FromReadingList, and writing the review back over Verdict in RecordVerdict. Both mutants were killed and the tree restored.
